events.invalidation: Iran de-escalation and Brent leaving the 105 area in a way that restores a disinflationary slowdown, with AONIA June 2027 implied reversing back through 4.9075 toward cash 4.35.
events.rationale: Brent at 105.28 with Iran pessimism is a supply-side inflation shock, not the demand-destruction tape a global slowdown receive needs. Long AONIA June 2027 is already through (entry 4.9075, mark 4.9325) while cash 4.35 still prices 65bp of hikes to 5.005; that path gets easier to deliver if energy inflation sticks, so the Australian receive is no longer the cleanest defensive line. Reduce it rather than holding full size into the oil headwind.

events.invalidation: The flatten is wrong if June 2027 AONIA holds or rises from 4.95 as a justified inflation-hike path while oil stays bid and cash AONIA lifts toward the implied.
events.rationale: June 2027 AONIA at 4.95 sits 60 basis points above cash 4.35, so the existing long-rate line is a hike-path long into unverified Australian demand while equities and a 16-handle VIX still treat the landing as benign. The same late-cycle tightening premium is in the SOFR strip and a 5.26 percent U.S. 10-year; a growth or financial-conditions tail compresses those implieds and punishes a pay-fixed Australian line. Close the live book at the frozen 4.95 print to exit anti-defensive exposure while it is still modestly through the 4.9075 entry.

events.invalidation: A further backup in the ten-year led by oil and term premium, with the S&P still bid and VIX still subdued, would mean the break has not arrived and receiving duration is early.
events.rationale: Ten-year yields at a twenty-four-year high have already tightened financial conditions that cash policy and a still-bid equity tape have not acknowledged. Receiving that long end is the defensive growth-break expression: oil is high, volatility is subdued, and the slowdown tail sits in duration that has already sold, not in fading a front-end hike path. The trade is wrong if crude and gold keep pushing yields through that extreme while equities never price the hit.

events.invalidation: A further selloff in the US 10-year driven by tighter policy and higher term premium with no growth break would hurt long duration.
events.rationale: Fragility is underpriced: VIX is 16.34, equities are bid, cash still sits below a hike-priced STIR strip, and oil is near 100. Receiving that strip would fade tightening already in the forwards, which is not a defensive trade. Buy the long end already sold at 5.24 and mark yields lower if growth or policy error arrives.
